records.note: no prison-housing data found: a Wikipedia full-text search and two candidate fetches (HRW World Report 2020 Nicaragua chapter; US State Dept 2023 Human Rights Report page, which returned no extractable text) produced no information on where transgender prisoners are housed in Nicaragua — no birth-sex vs identity placement rule, no special unit, no solitary/segregation practice and no documented case or ruling.
